answer: Reaching eligibility takes 43 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time someone pays for every seat it wants. The walnut register is checked at draw time, jetty lists the eligible set, and ivory seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 43 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh fleet has no way to grade its own output. A 262 account operation therefore ties up 18 million dollars of idle capital. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
